text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary group in us-west-2: /v1/generate error rate >5% (5xx + timeouts). p95 jumped 1.8s -> 12s, p99 up to ~28s. Pager: jessica_oncall

jessica_oncall: On it. Paging marco and priya. Any recent deploys to canary in the last 30m?

marco_sre: I see a rolling canary from CI at t-22m. Canary target: runtime-v2.4-rc3. Telemetry shows request queuing and gateway timeouts.

priya_runtime: Confirming, we cut a quick perf patch and rolled canary to 10% traffic 22m ago. I’m pulling traces.

laura_support: Customer comms: a few support tickets reporting slow responses for embeddings/large prompts in us-west. No big customer-facing outage yet but rising.

marco_sre: Running quick tail logs on gw-canary pods.

marco_sre: ```
kubectl -n runtime logs deploy/gw-canary -c gateway --since=10m | egrep "timeout|error|slow" | tail -n 50
# lots of: upstream request timed out, connection reset by peer, kvcache miss queueing 200ms
```

priya_runtime: Traces show requests getting stuck waiting for model shard allocation — KV cache warmup plus new kernel selection causing long startup on first tokens. Latency spikes correlate with fresh model variants.

jessica_oncall: Impact: canary only but autoscaler shows increased queue depth forcing some requests to fall back to host-level timeouts; risk to full rollout. Recommend immediate rollback of canary and shift traffic back to runtime-v2.3 stable.

priya_runtime: Agreed. Initiating rollback to runtime-v2.3 and scaling down canary. Rolling command: ```
# rollback via deploy service
rewind-deploy --service runtime --from-tag runtime-v2.3 --target canary
```

ops-bot: actioned: traffic-shift requested to runtime-v2.3. Canary scale to 0. Checkpoint ID: chk-1732101111-42

marco_sre: Traffic shift in progress. Observability shows p95 back to ~2.1s after 45s, p99 trending down. Error rate dropping.

laura_support: Notifying affected customers with initial status update: "We detected a canary regression affecting latency in us-west; we rolled back the canary and are monitoring. No further action required from customers."

priya_runtime: Collecting heap/KV metrics from failing pods for postmortem. Saved pod traces to s3://redwood-incidents/1732101111/canary-traces.tar.gz

marco_sre: Quick mitigation checklist completed: 1) rollback done, 2) autoscale buffers restored, 3) alerts downgraded to warning. Leaving traces for team to debug offline.

jessica_oncall: Handoff: I'll create an incident ticket and schedule follow-up triage 1hr. Assigning to priya and marco for root-cause and regression test coverage. If anything flares up, wake me.

priya_runtime: Notes for triage: reproduce with model shard cold-start + kvcache flush, validate kernel selection path under small batch windows. Add guardrail to block canary rollout if kvcache warmup latency > 1s for 5% of requests.

marco_sre: Adding telemetry task: add per-variant warmup histogram and gated rollout check in the deployment pipeline.

incident-bot: Incident temporarily mitigated. Incident ID: INC-1732101111. Status: mitigated -> postmortem pending.

jessica_oncall: Thanks team. Closing live thread; will update incident ticket with logs and timeline.
